about: Which implementation writes a home: the one table the Rust decider (crates/cf-base/src/way_back.rs, read here by tests/way_back.rs) and the Node one (src/use-node.js, read by tests/way-back.test.mjs) are both held to. Each case makes `state` at <home>/use-node, with the home named by CONSENSFLOW_HOME and again by HOME alone (<HOME>/.consensflow), and every `strays` environment on top: the answer is `node` and the same in all of them. A case with `unix` is made on Unix only: a link needs a privilege on Windows, and Windows has no mode that takes the right to read a file or to search a folder away from the user who owns it.

cases.name: no file is in the home
the file is there, with something in it
the file is there and empty
a folder has the file's name
the file is there and nobody may read it
the home's folder cannot be searched
